How Do I Trade on Weather Markets? Kalshi creates a prediction market around a specific temperature threshold for a given location. For example: “Highest temperature in Chicago on April 15, 2025?” ​ Contract prices for temperature ranges may shift as new weather data (e.g., forecasts, model runs, satellite images, observations) becomes available. Note: Not all weather data is the same. Apps like AccuWeather, iOS Weather, or Google Weather may be useful for guidance but do not determine contract outcomes. Market determination may be delayed in the rare instances of a) a high temperature is not consistent with 6-hr or 24-hr highs reported by METAR or b) the final NWS Climate Report high temperature value is lower than previous preliminary report. ​ Hourly Temperature Markets Some temperature markets are hourly - the market title names an exact time, for example “Chicago temperature at 5 PM EDT.” These markets are also directional: each contract resolves on whether the temperature at that time is above or below a specific level, rather than within a range.
